summary: Iranian hard-liners allegedly sabotaged a U.S.-Iran peace agreement by orchestrating attacks on three commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz, according to the New York Times citing Iranian officials. Houthi forces struck King Khalid Air Base in Khamis Mushait, Saudi Arabia with dozens of missiles and drones, while a U.S. F-15 was shot down near Isfahan, Iran, with both pilots surviving. IDF forces are conducting intensive operations across multiple fronts including Gaza, Lebanon's Ali Taher Ridge, and Al-Khiyam.
key_points: Iranian hard-liners linked to cleric Hossein Taeb sabotaged a U.S.-Iran peace deal by attacking three commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz; President Pezeshkian was reportedly unaware and confronted IRGC commander Gen. Ahmad Vahidi (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7101).

Houthi forces attacked King Khalid Air Base in Khamis Mushait, Saudi Arabia with dozens of missiles and drones, targeting aircraft hangars, radar systems, runways, and ammunition depots, causing significant losses (Source: @yediotnews25/134957).

A U.S. F-15 was shot down near Isfahan, Iran; pilots Alpha and Bravo ejected and survived, with Bravo sustaining fractures and injuries after landing approximately 8km from Alpha in rugged desert terrain (Source: @VahidOnline/78362).

IDF's Maglan unit completed a covert operation in Al-Khiyam, Lebanon, advancing 13km deep into enemy territory, dismantling Hezbollah networks and seizing the city in under two days (Source: @idf_telegram/25124).

IDF Defense Minister Katz declared Ali Taher Ridge part of Israel's yellow line and 700 sq km security zone in Lebanon, stating IDF is operating militarily for control and will not retreat until Hezbollah is disarmed (Source: @New_security8200/203787).

Chinese entities allegedly supplied Iran with high-resolution satellite images of a U.S. air base in Jordan, which Iran subsequently struck in a missile attack killing three American troops, according to Fox News (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7106).

IDF struck targets in Gaza city near Shifa Hospital, as well as in Dir al-Balah and Nuseirat, in attempts to neutralize terrorists, with results still being verified (Source: @New_security8200/203789).

Houthi missile attacks caused direct damage to an oil facility in Jizan, Saudi Arabia, while an emergency warning was issued for Abha, Saudi Arabia, later confirmed as passed (Source: @kianmeli1/91942, @shin_persian/9887).

sections.executive_summary: Iranian hard-liners allegedly sabotaged a U.S.-Iran peace agreement by orchestrating attacks on three commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz, according to the New York Times citing Iranian officials and IRGC members. Houthi forces struck King Khalid Air Base in Khamis Mushait, Saudi Arabia with dozens of missiles and drones in retaliation for over 300 Saudi airstrikes in Yemen. A U.S. F-15 was shot down near Isfahan, Iran, with both pilots surviving after ejecting into rugged desert terrain.

sections.threat_assessment: The conflict is expanding across multiple simultaneous fronts with escalating severity. Iran's internal power struggle between hard-liners and reformists threatens to destabilize any diplomatic resolution, as the hard-line faction has gained the upper hand and actively sabotaged peace efforts. Houthi forces are demonstrating increasingly sophisticated strike capabilities against Saudi military and oil infrastructure, while Iran's alleged provision of satellite intelligence to support attacks on U.S. forces indicates deepening Iran-China military cooperation. The shootdown of a U.S. F-15 over Iran represents a significant escalation of direct hostilities between Washington and Tehran.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia has requested the postponement of diplomatic engagement with Iran on Strait of Hormuz arrangements, signaling heightened security concerns. President Trump has indicated the Iran issue may be resolved before the U.S. midterms, with Iran reportedly eager to sign a deal, though hard-line elements within Tehran appear to be undermining negotiations. The UAE suffered casualties among its servicemen during training, suggesting Gulf states are under active threat. Iran continues to deny involvement in Yemeni attacks on Saudi Arabia while simultaneously being implicated in attacks on U.S. forces.
sections.intelligence_notes: The convergence of Iranian internal sabotage of peace talks, Chinese logistical support for Iranian military operations, and Houthi expansion of strikes into Saudi oil infrastructure suggests a coordinated multi-actor escalation. The Ali Taher tunnel complex in Lebanon, where Hezbollah fighters were reportedly present, represents a significant underground threat that IDF is actively targeting. Satellite imagery from multiple sources confirms the movement of fast boats near Kharg Island and damage to Saudi oil infrastructure, indicating the conflict's reach into critical energy infrastructure. The U.S. pilot rescue operation in Iran's rugged terrain underscores the operational risks now facing American forces in the region.
